methods.name: Dentsu Creative Quantitative Research 2025
methods.description: Global online survey of consumers (n≈20k across 18 markets) that provides the statistical backbone for the report – e.g., 53 % of respondents say they use AI-enabled chat platforms in their personal lives and 32 % feel their chatbot sometimes understands them better than friends/family.

methods.name: Desk Research & Cultural Trend Scanning
methods.description: Continuous secondary research that aggregates brand case-studies, media coverage and cultural signals into themed trend narratives (Escape Velocity, Electric Dreams, Trad Lives, Alone Together, Analog Futures). Examples include the rise of ultra-realistic AI influencers and the growth of individual streamers winning sports-broadcast rights.
